head: Recimora app saves recipes from TikTok and Instagram screenshots
dek: Recimora is a new iPhone and iPad app that turns a screenshot of a TikTok or Instagram recipe into a written recipe with ingredients and steps, finds a photo of the dish and files it in your own cookbook. It also reads food blog links, cookbook pages and handwritten recipe cards.
details: It can scale a recipe to the number of people, has a cooking mode with large text that keeps the screen on, plans the week and builds shopping lists sorted by store aisle. The free version imports up to 5 recipes; writing recipes by hand, cooking mode and shopping lists stay free. Premium, a monthly or yearly subscription, unlocks unlimited imports, all twelve cookbook styles and menu suggestions. Recipes are stored on the phone; signing in with Apple or Google is optional and keeps a copy in your account.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, free with a Premium subscription
means: If your camera roll is full of recipe screenshots you never find again, this app puts them in one place as recipes you can cook from.
todo: Try it with up to five of your saved screenshots on the free version before you decide on Premium; the listing doesn't show the subscription price.
